name: Merchant Mastery
body:
Your travelers are particularly skilled at making money through trade.

Prerequisite: Morale 3.

Benefit: You gain a +5 bonus on all special Resolve checks made to trade goods.

Special: You can gain this feat up to three times. Its effects stack.
